content: Turbopack (Next.js 16 default) does not statically resolve the new URL('x.wasm', import.meta.url) pattern that wasm-bindgen's --target web glue uses internally for its zero-arg init(). Workaround: place the .wasm binary in public/ and call the generated init() with an explicit URL string pointing at the public path, bypassing Turbopack's asset-graph analysis entirely (this is a supported, documented init() argument form, not a hack).
